title: StreamPro: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Grained Rewards for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2605.16381v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Proactive streaming video understanding requires models to continuously monitor evolving video streams and decide whether, when, and what to respond. However, training models with such proactive capabilities remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) suffers from severe imbalance between silence and response signals, while reinforcement learning (RL) faces sparse response-level rewards and difficulties in optimizing interdependent response sequences. To address these challenges, we propose StreamPro, a two-stage training framework. We first introduce CB-Stream Loss to alleviate supervision imbalance during SFT. We then employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with two complementary rewards: a refined Response-Matching (RM) reward that provides denser feedback for individual response decisions, and a rubric-based Sequence-Quality (SQ) reward that encourages globally coherent response sequences. translated_title: StreamPro：基于多粒度奖励强化学习的主动式流式视频理解
translated_abstract: 主动式流式视频理解要求模型持续监控不断演化的视频流，并决定是否响应、何时响应以及响应什么内容。然而，训练具备这种主动能力的模型仍然具有挑战性。监督微调（SFT）存在沉默信号与响应信号之间的严重不平衡问题，而强化学习（RL）则面临响应级别奖励稀疏以及难以优化相互依赖的响应序列的困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了StreamPro，一个两阶段训练框架。我们首先引入CB-Stream Loss来缓解SFT期间的监督不平衡问题。随后我们采用群体相对策略优化（GRPO），并配合两种互补的奖励：一种精细化的响应匹配（RM）奖励，为单个响应决策提供更密集的反馈；以及一种基于评分准则的序列质量（SQ）奖励，鼓励生成全局连贯的响应序列。为了支持这两种（奖励机制……）
tldr: 提出StreamPro两阶段训练框架，先用CB-Stream Loss缓解SFT中沉默与响应信号的监督不平衡，再通过响应匹配奖励与序列质量奖励相结合的多粒度GRPO强化学习，解决奖励稀疏与响应序列依赖优化的难题，实现主动式流式视频理解。
en_tdlr: StreamPro is a two-stage training framework that leverages CB-Stream Loss to mitigate SFT supervision imbalance and employs multi-grained GRPO rewards—combining dense response-matching feedback with rubric-based sequence-quality evaluation—to enable proactive streaming video understanding.
